observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to configure a team-specific opt-out for retaining code variables in stack frames, and the code enforces this opt-out. This could help PostHog support older SDK senders that attach frame locals without masking, while retaining the ability to remove those variables for teams that opt in.
